leo1.text: [whispers] Take Leo. It's one in the morning, [pause] and a headline just made him furious.

leo2.text: [mischievously] He doesn't question a word. [pause] Read. [pause] Believe. [pause] Repost.

leo3.text: [sighs] By morning, two hundred people have shared it. [pause] Nobody asked if the argument held up.

cold1.text: [serious] Leo isn't alone. Every day, billions of us read, share and reply, [pause] and almost nobody stops to check the argument.

mit.text: [gravely] On Twitter, false stories were seventy percent more likely to be retweeted than true ones.

wef.text: [ominous] And in 2024, and again in 2025, the World Economic Forum ranked misinformation the number one global risk for the next two years.

pivot.text: [intensely] We have spam filters. We have spell-check. [long pause] But nothing checks our logic.

vision.text: [hopeful] What if a partner questioned the argument, [pause] whether you're reading it, or writing it?

intro.text: [confident] Meet Socrates: critical thinking, built into your browser. It flags weak arguments in what you read, and in what you write.

d1.text: [calm] Open an article, and it reads along with you.

d2.text: [suspenseful] When the reasoning slips, the exact words get tagged.

d3.text: Click the tag. [pause] Socrates won't tell you what to think. It asks the question that helps you decide.

d4.text: [serious] In your inbox, pressure tactics get caught before you click.

d5a.text: [amused] And it checks your own replies too.

d5b.text: [amused] Subtle, it is not. [pause] Rethink it, and the flag clears.

science.text: [confident] It knows dozens of fallacies, biases and pressure tactics, [pause] and stays quiet when the reasoning holds.

privacy.text: [warmly] It reads only the article, email or reply in front of you, [pause] and it never tells you what to believe.

impact.text: For students, for families, for anyone with an inbox: [pause] every headline becomes a chance to think twice.

outro.text: [warmly] Socrates. [pause] Critical thinking, built into your browser.
